Name: Simple Resource Multiplier
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]Simple Resource Multiplier[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Get more from chopping and mining, with a separate chance and total quantity multiplier for each resource group. Requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌲 Nine Resource Groups[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Wood • Hardwood • Stone • Ore • Gems
Optional: Sap • Tree Seeds • Coal • Geodes[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Each group has its own On/Off switch, activation chance from 0–100%, and total quantity multiplier from 1×–500×. Only resources that actually drop can receive a bonus.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Example: 5 wood at 3× becomes 15 wood in total when the bonus activates. A failed chance roll leaves the original drop unchanged.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54039/54039-1792248633-183973552.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎲 Optional Random Multipliers[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Turn on Random Multiplier for any resource group and choose an inclusive minimum and maximum from 1×–500×. Random mode starts Off, with a suggested range of 2×–5× when enabled. Leave it Off to use that group’s fixed multiplier.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]After the activation chance succeeds, one whole-number multiplier is chosen for that resource group’s drops in the event. For example, 5 wood with a 2×–5× range can become 10, 15, 20 or 25 wood in total. A 1× result adds nothing.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙️ Choose Your Rewards[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Wood, hardwood, stone, ore and gems start enabled at 100% chance and 2× quantity. Sap, tree seeds, coal and geodes start disabled.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Optional tree shaking applies the sap and tree-seed settings to actual wild-tree drops. Empty shakes do not create items. Fruit-tree shaking is excluded.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54039/54039-1792248633-159159680.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings, or edit the generated config.json while the game is closed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]💻 PC & 📱 Experimental Android[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Download one edition only. Both editions use the same mod ID and settings format.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC: Stardew Valley 1.6 with compatible SMAPI 4.x. Prepared and checked against game 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Android: experimental download targeting game 1.6.15.3 and a compatible Android SMAPI port with API 4.3.2 or newer. Physical-phone, touch and Android-loader testing is still pending; compatibility with every port is not guaranteed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Install the SMAPI version appropriate to your platform. Extract the chosen download into your Mods folder and launch through SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Do not install the PC and Android editions together.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🔎 Compatibility & Limits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Single-player only: resource bonuses are inactive in multiplayer and split-screen. XP is not multiplied. Purchases, machines, fruit-tree shaking, prismatic shards, cinder shards and special or quest rewards are excluded.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Modded trees and nodes need compatible game drop callbacks and supported resource data. Focused checks with Simple Skills Extended and Simple World Tiers passed, but full-modpack and copied-save gameplay checks are still pending. Other drop-changing mods can affect the final result.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]The gallery shows isolated PC settings renders, not live gameplay or Android screenshots. Genuine gameplay captures are not yet available.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. Translations are AI-assisted and still welcome native-speaker corrections.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please report bugs or share ideas on this mod’s page. For bugs, include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, reproduction steps, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful. For suggestions, explain what you would like changed and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
